{"toolsets":{"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset":{"name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Provides tools for working with Blueprints: graphs, functions, events, event dispatchers,
nodes, pins, comment boxes, node notes, variables, and interfaces.","tools":[{"description":"Sets the tooltip shown for a Blueprint variable in the editor.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetVariableTooltip","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets the replication mode on a Blueprint member variable. REP_NOTIFY will automatically
create an OnRep_ function on the Blueprint if one does not already exist.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetVariableReplication","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets whether a member variable is Blueprint Read Only. A read-only variable can still be
read by graphs, but a setter can no longer be created for it. Local variables are not
supported. The Blueprint must be recompiled for the change to take effect.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetVariableReadOnly","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets whether a member variable is editable per-instance on actors placed in the level.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetVariableInstanceEditable","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets the user-defined category on a Blueprint variable. Pass an empty string to reset to
the default (the Blueprint's name).","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetVariableCategory","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets the value of a Blueprint graph pin. Must be an input pin that supports default values.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetPinValue","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Reparents a Blueprint to a new parent class. The Blueprint must be recompiled afterward.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetParent","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets a new position for the node.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetNodePosition","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets whether a node's note bubble is pinned (always visible), vs. only shown on hover.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetNodeNotePinned","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets the note text on a Blueprint node (its comment bubble). The bubble is made immediately
visible in the graph editor when a non-empty note is set.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetNodeNote","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets detail-panel settings on a Blueprint function. Only the fields set on Flags are
applied; leave a field unset to keep the function's current value for that flag. The
Blueprint must be recompiled for the changes to take effect.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetFunctionFlags","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Binds a function to a Create Event node. Use ListCompatibleEventFunctions to find valid
function names.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetCreateEventFunction","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets the text on a comment box.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.SetCommentBoxText","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Replaces a node's baked-in class reference from OldClass to NewClass in place, and
reconstructs the node so its pins reflect the new type. A no-op if the node already
references NewClass. The Blueprint must be recompiled after retargeting is complete.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.RetargetNodeClass","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Removes a member or local variable from a Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.RemoveVariable","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Removes a specific pin from a node that supports dynamic pin removal.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.RemoveNodePin","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Removes an implemented interface from a Blueprint. The Blueprint must be recompiled afterward.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.RemoveInterface","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Removes an input or output from a function or event dispatcher. Output params are not
supported on event dispatchers.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.RemoveFunctionParam","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Removes a function graph or event dispatcher from the Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.RemoveFunctionGraph","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Removes a comment box from its graph.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.RemoveCommentBox","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Lists a Blueprint's variables in one scope, leaving out ones a graph cannot read.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListVariables","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists the interfaces implemented by a Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListInterfaces","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists all graphs in the Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListGraphs","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists all functions visible on the Blueprint - locally defined plus inheritable ones from
the parent class chain and implemented interfaces.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListFunctions","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists all events visible on the Blueprint - locally defined custom events plus inheritable
events from the parent class chain and implemented interfaces.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListEvents","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists all event dispatchers defined on a Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListEventDispatchers","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists the bindable delegate events available on a component.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListComponentEvents","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists functions that can be bound to a Create Event node.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListCompatibleEventFunctions","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists all comment boxes in a Blueprint graph.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ListCommentBoxes","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns whether a node's note bubble is pinned (always visible).","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.IsNodeNotePinned","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the tooltip shown for a Blueprint variable in the editor.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetVariableTooltip","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the replication mode of a Blueprint member variable.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetVariableReplication","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets whether a member variable is Blueprint Read Only (graphs can read but not write it).","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetVariableReadOnly","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the user-defined category of a Blueprint variable. Categories group variables in the
My Blueprint panel. Variables with no explicit category default to the Blueprint's name.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetVariableCategory","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the value of a Blueprint graph pin. Must be an input pin that supports default values.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetPinValue","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the parent class of a Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetParent","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the pin names and types for a node type.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetNodeTypePins","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the nodes grouped inside a comment box.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetNodesInCommentBox","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the note text on a Blueprint node (the small comment bubble shown over an
individual node).","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetNodeNote","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Retrieves detailed information for a list of Blueprint graph nodes.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetNodeInfos","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Retrieves a specific graph from a Blueprint asset by name.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetGraph","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the detail-panel settings of a Blueprint function.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetFunctionFlags","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the signature a Create Event node's bound function must implement. Each param is
listed on its own line with its type, direction and passing mode, in the terms
AddFunctionParam takes.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetDelegateSignature","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the Class Default Object (CDO) for a Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetDefaultObject","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the function currently bound to a Create Event node.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetCreateEventFunction","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns detailed information for all nodes connected to the given node, including itself.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetConnectedSubgraph","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the text of a comment box.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.GetCommentBoxText","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Finds node types that can be created in a particular graph matching the search criteria. To
list all nodes within a category, use a trailing pipe (e.g. "Utilities|FlowControl|").
The results are palette type ids (Category|Name), not Graph DSL references.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.FindNodeTypes","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Finds nodes in a graph by title, class, and/or execution role. All filters are optional and
ANDed together.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.FindNodes","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Retrieves the available node categories in a Blueprint graph, optionally filtered by
compatible pin types. Categories are everything before the last '|' in a node type_id.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.FindNodeCategories","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Breaks two connected pins.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.DisconnectPins","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Compares two versions of a graph with the same matching the editor's Diff window uses.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.DiffGraphs","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Deletes the node from its graph.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.DeleteNode","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a new node to the graph.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.CreateNode","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Creates a new Blueprint asset in the project.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.Create","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Makes a connection between source (output) and dest (input) pins.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ConnectPins","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Compiles the given Blueprint. Blueprints should be compiled after all graph modifications
are complete.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.CompileBlueprint","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Arranges Nodes in a readable left-to-right layout, using every other node in Graph as a
fixed anchor so the arranged subset integrates cleanly with the rest of the graph. Comment
boxes whose members are all in the touched region are rebuilt to fit.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ArrangeNodes","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Arranges a whole graph in a readable left-to-right layout, per connected component: each
component becomes a horizontal band, execution chains hold a single straight row, and
comment boxes are honored as nested groups and rebuilt around their members. Does not
require an open graph editor.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.ArrangeGraphLayered","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a member or local variable to a Blueprint.

Supported type names: primitives (bool, int, float, byte, string, name, text), structs
(Vector, Rotator, Transform, Vector2D, LinearColor), and the bare name or object path of
any UEnum or UScriptStruct.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddVariable","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a member or local variable of a struct type to a Blueprint. Use this to add variables
of any UStruct type, including custom structs and engine structs not in the basic list
supported by AddVariable (e.g. HitResult, GameplayTag).","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddStructVariable","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a struct input or output to a function or event dispatcher. Output params are not
supported on event dispatchers.

Use this to add parameters of any UStruct type, including custom structs and engine structs
not in the basic list supported by AddFunctionParam (e.g. HitResult, GameplayTag).","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddStructFunctionParam","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a member or local variable that holds an object reference to a Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddObjectVariable","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds an object reference input or output to a function or event dispatcher. Output params
are not supported on event dispatchers.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddObjectFunctionParam","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a pin to a node that supports dynamic pin addition (Switch, Sequence, commutative
binary operators like Add/Multiply, Make Array, etc.).","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddNodePin","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a function graph matching a Create Event node's delegate signature and binds it.

The generated function's params match the delegate exactly, including the passing mode of
each param. The node's OutputDelegate pin must be connected first; the signature is read
from it. Idempotent - if a graph of the requested name already exists and matches the
delegate it is bound and returned.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddMatchingDelegateFunction","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a custom event matching a Create Event node's delegate signature and binds it.

The generated event's params match the delegate exactly. Signatures with output params or a
return value cannot be implemented by an event - use AddMatchingDelegateFunction for those.
The node's OutputDelegate pin must be connected first; the signature is read from it.
Idempotent - if an event of the requested name already exists and matches the delegate it
is bound and returned.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddMatchingDelegateEvent","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds an interface to a Blueprint's implemented interfaces. The interface's function-shape
members become function graphs on the Blueprint, and its event-shape members become
overridable events. The Blueprint must be recompiled for the change to take effect.
Idempotent - adding an interface the Blueprint already implements is a no-op.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddInterface","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds an input or output to a function or event dispatcher. Output params are not supported
on event dispatchers.

Supported parameter types: primitives (bool, int, float, byte, string, name, text),
structs (Vector, Rotator, Transform, Vector2D, LinearColor), and the bare name or object
path of any UEnum or UScriptStruct.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddFunctionParam","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a function graph to the Blueprint.

If GraphName matches an inherited overridable function, the new graph is a function-graph
override of that function. Idempotent - if a graph with that name already exists, that
graph is returned.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddFunctionGraph","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds an event dispatcher to a Blueprint.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddEventDispatcher","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds an event node to the Blueprint's event graph.

If EventName matches an inherited overridable event, the new node is an override of that
event. Otherwise a new custom event with the given name is created. Idempotent - if an
event node with that name already exists, that node is returned.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddEvent","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Creates a component bound event node in the event graph.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddComponentBoundEvent","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds a comment box (the resizable labeled rectangle) to a Blueprint graph. Pass Nodes to
wrap them in a box sized to their bounds, or pass Rect to place a standalone box.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintToolset.AddCommentBox","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}}]}},"errors":{}}
